subject: Rapid PoC handshake & success metrics — ClearPath
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Evan Miller <evan@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 May 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rapid PoC handshake & success metrics — ClearPath

Hi Evan / Alyssa —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight PoC plan so we can move to a signed test within two weeks. Please confirm anything that looks off or add items I missed.

Scope (30 day Rapid PoC):
- Inference surface: document summarization + single-turn Q&A over customer docs (same split we demo'd).
- Traffic shape: synthetic replay of 3k unique docs, target peak of 120 r/s and sustained 40 r/s for 30 minutes.
- Data: customer will provide a 5k doc sample (anonymized) + schema for PII flags. Redwood will not persist raw docs outside ephemeral cache.

Success criteria (minimum pass to move to pilot):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 200ms server-side for 512-token context during peak replay.
- Throughput: system sustains 100 r/s with <5% error rate for 30 minutes.
- Cost: average token cost <= $0.0009/token (including batching and KV cache benefit) across runs.
- Quality: ROUGE-L on summarization >= 0.62 on your evaluation set; Q&A exact-match >= 78% on the 200 sample questions we'll share.

Operational checks / constraints:
- KV cache will be enabled; we will provide a 24-hour TTL for cached prefixes.
- Model variant: start on the curated-open-12B quantized profile; fallback to 8-bit variant allowed if latency spikes.
- Security: we will demonstrate KMS key usage and provide audit logs for token-level traces during the run.

Owners & next steps:
- Customer deliverable: ClearPath provides 5k-doc sample + 200 Q&A pairs by EOD Tue (Alyssa).
- Redwood deliverable: Ben to provision the dedicated sandbox, Soojin to create eval harness and metric dashboard, Priya will own timeline and acceptance.
- Kickoff run window: target Wed (May 7) morning PT for smoke; full replay Thurs (May 8).

Attachments: I attached a short scope doc and a sample load script stub — will update after we get your sample data.

If that looks good, please reply with a one-line confirmation and we'll lock dates.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
(Attachment: clearpath_poc_scope.pdf)
From: Evan Miller <evan@clearpath.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearpath.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid PoC handshake & success metrics — ClearPath

Priya —

Thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned on scope and like the compact timeline. A few clarifications and one ask from our security team: 

1) Latency target — can you confirm whether the 95th percentile target is measured end-to-end (client-to-client) or server-side (Redwood only)? We budgeted 250ms E2E but can accept 200ms server-side.
2) Quality thresholds — the ROUGE-L threshold is fine, but can we allow a +3% grace for the first week while we iterate prompts?
3) Security — we need proof of non-persistence for raw docs and access to the audit log export after the run. Our security lead also requests a short SOC 2 scoping note.

We will provide:
- 5k anonymized docs by Tue EOD (Alyssa).
- 200 Q&A pairs by Tue (evan@clearpath.ai).

One ask: can Redwood provide a small sample run with 10% of the data (local replay) this Wed so we can sanity-check the eval harness before the full replay on Thurs? That would help us validate data shape and prompt variants.

Happy to confirm once you reply on the latency measurement and SOC note.

Best,
Evan Miller
Director of Platform — ClearPath AI
evan@clearpath.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 May 2025 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid PoC handshake & success metrics — ClearPath

PRIYA / TEAM —

Quick ops notes based on Evan's questions:
- Latency: we'll report both server-side and an estimated E2E delta; include client network delta as a separate column. For pass/fail, keep server-side 95p <200ms as the gating metric.
- Grace on quality: we'll accept a +3% soft grace in the first week but include a regression alert if quality doesn't reach target by week 2.
- Security: I'll attach a 1-page SOC-scope stub and we'll enable audit log export to the Drive link provided.

Owners I assigned: 
- Sandbox provisioning: Ben (done, instance id: rd-sbx-clp-12)
- Eval harness + dashboards: Soojin (shared dashboard link will be live by Tue morning)
- Prompt iteration & quality triage: Marissa (will own nightly prompt runs and issue tracker)
- Timeline owner & stakeholder updates: Priya

Attached: poctest-plan.csv (load timings, sample sizes) and a small sample_load_script.zip. I'll run the 10% sanity replay Wed 09:00 PT and drop results in the dashboard.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
(Attachment: poctest-plan.csv)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Evan Miller <evan@clearpath.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 May 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid PoC handshake & success metrics — ClearPath

Thanks all — good alignment. Two quick confirmations so we can lock the calendar: 

1) Latency gating: server-side 95p <200ms will be the pass metric; Redwood will additionally provide an estimated E2E column.
2) Security: Redwood will provide the SOC-2 scoping note and the audit log export after the full replay.

Planned run cadence: 
- Wed 07 May 09:00 PT: 10% sanity replay (Ben runs, Soojin monitors dashboard)
- Thu 08 May 08:30 PT: Full replay window (120 r/s peak, 30m sustained)
- Fri 09 May: Readout + acceptance check against the four success criteria (latency, throughput, cost, quality).

If we hear nothing else, we'll assume these dates are good and proceed. Evan / Alyssa: one-line OK is enough.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
(Attachment: clearpath_poc_scope.pdf)
